summary.en: Platform for running machine learning models with simple API and pay-per-use pricing.
summary.zh: 运行机器学习模型的平台，提供简单的 API 和按使用付费的定价。

title.en: Replicate API Key - Machine Learning Model Platform | Get Model Key
title.zh: Replicate API Key - 机器学习模型平台 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Replicate API key for machine learning models. Run thousands of community models with simple API.
description.zh: 获取 Replicate API Key，访问机器学习模型。使用简单的 API 运行数千个社区模型。

en: Replicate hosts and runs machine learning models through a simple HTTP API, covering image, language, and other community and vendor models.
Billing is generally usage-based (pay for what you run). Exact rates belong on Replicate’s official pricing pages.
zh: Replicate 通过简洁的 HTTP API 托管并运行机器学习模型，覆盖图像、语言等社区与厂商模型。
计费通常按实际运行用量；具体费率以 Replicate 官方定价页为准。

en: Sign in at https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens (create an account if needed).
Generate a new API token and copy it to a secure secret store.
Authenticate requests with the token per replicate.com/docs.
Delete unused tokens from the same account page to reduce risk.
zh: 登录 https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens （如无账号请先注册）。
生成新的 API Token，并保存到安全的密钥存储。
按 replicate.com/docs 用该 Token 鉴权发起请求。
在同一账号页删除闲置 Token，降低泄露风险。

answer.en: Running hosted ML models via API without managing your own GPU stack—especially image and community models.
answer.zh: 适合通过 API 运行托管 ML 模型、免自建 GPU，尤其是图像与社区模型场景。

question.en: Do you list Replicate prices here?
question.zh: 这里有 Replicate 报价吗？

answer.en: No. Check Replicate’s official pricing; we avoid quoting fees that may change.
answer.zh: 没有。请查看 Replicate 官方定价；本站不引用易变费用。

question.en: Can getModelKey give me a Replicate token?
question.zh: getModelKey 能给我 Replicate Token 吗？

answer.en: No. Create tokens only on the official account API tokens page.
answer.zh: 不能。请只在官方账号 API Tokens 页面创建。
